reviewScope: Complete lexical candidate review of ProductCatalog2D catalog data. Human-readable module, finish, option, benefit, component, requirement, accessory and service content is authored product content; IDs, schema, asset/style values, evidence references and structural measurements are technical.
limitations: Inventory only; catalog data and localization resources remain unchanged.
Product/catalog ownership must decide whether authored labels/specifications/descriptions are localized in catalog records or mapped to UI resources, preserving identifiers and commercial meaning.
